title: Traditional German Puff Pastry
description: A classic German pastry filled with a delicious zesty filling, made with a flaky puff dough. Perfect as a snack or dessert.

ingredients.name: zesty filling
ingredients.notes: mix of lemon juice, sugar, eggs, and vanilla extract

instructions: Roll out the puff dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Spread the zesty filling over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the granulated sugar over the filling.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Use a sharp knife to cut the pastry into diamonds or squares.
Serve warm, dust with powdered sugar if desired.
